guard: The LIVE winner of a race is the arm with the least recorded branch clock among the settled arms, never the arm declared first or the arm that woke first. (FAIL-FAST suite: markers are upstream of the cells they guard.)

mutations.name: the live pick takes the first settled arm in declaration order and ignores the clocks
mutations.expectRed: a live race is decided by the recorded clocks, not by which arm woke first
mutations.completionMarker: ok the live pass records a winner (a simulator tie, broken by declaration order)
mutations.cell: a live race is decided by the recorded clocks, not by which arm woke first
mutations.note: The serial simulator ties both arms' clocks, so the section 1 live cell cannot see this mutant (a tie falls to declaration order under both rules); the section 1b handler stamps the arm that woke first with the LATER clock, so only the rule picks `fast`.

mutations.name: the live pick takes the GREATEST clock
mutations.expectRed: a live race is decided by the recorded clocks, not by which arm woke first
mutations.completionMarker: ok the live pass records a winner (a simulator tie, broken by declaration order)
mutations.cell: a live race is decided by the recorded clocks, not by which arm woke first
mutations.note: Same shape as the first mutant, from the other side: proves the cell holds the DIRECTION of the comparison and not just its presence.
